intro.title: What is it and why does it exist?
intro.paragraph1: Prod-UIBO is a web-based productivity timer designed to help users manage their time and stay focused during work or study sessions. Unlike other timers, its core is personalization, letting users fully adapt the visual and audio environment to create an ideal space for concentration.
intro.paragraph2: Most productivity tools are functional but visually dull, or beautiful but lacking flexibility. Prod-UIBO was born from the need for a tool that doesn't force you to choose. The goal was to build a timer that isn't just a stopwatch, but a truly customizable workspace that users actually enjoy using, combining modern design with detailed configuration.
intro.highlightPrefix: Prod-UIBO isn't just a stopwatch — it's a
intro.highlightSuffix: that adapts to you, not the other way around.

pomodoro.title: The Pomodoro Technique
pomodoro.intro: Prod-UIBO implements the famous Pomodoro technique, a proven method to maximize productivity and keep your mind focused.

steps.title: Choose a task
steps.description: Pick a specific activity that requires your full attention

steps.title: 25 minutes of focus
steps.description: Set the timer and work without interruptions until it rings

steps.title: 5-minute break
steps.description: Take a short break to recharge your mental energy

steps.title: Repeat the cycle
steps.description: After 4 pomodoros, take a long break of 15-30 minutes

cards.title: Immersive Personalization
cards.description: Choose between static themes and animated video backgrounds. Each theme adjusts the interface and text colors to ensure readability and create a unique atmosphere.

cards.title: Ambient Sounds
cards.description: Includes a background sound player (rain, music, etc.) with volume control to block out distractions and improve concentration.

cards.title: Total Flexibility
cards.description: From preset timers to manual input and a built-in task list. Includes a Mini Mode for a compact, distraction-free view.

status.betaNotice: This app is in testing and has not been officially released yet. It may contain bugs or frequent changes.
items: Software: Version 1.0 functional and deployed. The web app is fully operational.

Implemented Features: Complete timer system (start, pause, reset, stop), task management, and a robust settings panel with general options, a theme system (static and animated) and background sound control with volume.
Coming Soon: Cloud sync to save your tasks and settings, and a mobile app to access Prod-UIBO from anywhere.

footer.description: The ultimate productivity companion for those who want to achieve more, reduce stress, and master their time with the Pomodoro technique and a fully customizable visual and audio environment.
